# Shift4 Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results


Nov 05, 2026 7:00 AM EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_f28129066f1ecca5cca9f7126587b59d/shift4/news/2026-11-05_Shift4_Announces_Third_Quarter_2026_310.pdf)


## Related Documents


[Shareholder Letter](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_f28129066f1ecca5cca9f7126587b59d/shift4/db/3583/33872/pdf/Shareholder_Letter_Q3_2026.pdf)


[PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_f28129066f1ecca5cca9f7126587b59d/shift4/db/3583/33872/pdf/Shareholder_Letter_Q3_2026.pdf)

CENTER VALLEY, Pa.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) has posted its third quarter 2026 financial results as part of its Q3 2026 Shareholder Letter, which can be viewed[here](https://investors.shift4.com/news-events/presentations/id/33872) or by navigating to the Financials section of its Investor Relations website at[https://investors.shift4.com](https://investors.shift4.com/overview/default.aspx) .


**Earnings Conference Call**


Management will host a conference call today, November 5th, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET to discuss the results.


**Conference Call Details** Toll-free dial-in: +1-888-660-6196
Toll dial-in: +1-929-203-1911
Conference ID: FOURQ326


The earnings conference call will also be webcast live and interested parties can join the live webcast through Shift4’s website at:[https://investors.shift4.com](https://investors.shift4.com/)


**X Spaces Simulcast**


As previously announced, the live audio of the earnings call will be simulcast via X Spaces. Follow @Shift4 on X for additional information on how to access the simulcast.


**About Shift4**


Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) powers the experience economy, enabling businesses to deliver the moments that matter. Transforming how people shop, dine, stay, and play, Shift4’s commerce technology allows for a seamless experience at any scale. From your neighborhood restaurant to the world’s largest event venues, Shift4 handles billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses around the world. For more information, visit[shift4.com](https://www.shift4.com/) .
